protocol: Hush AgentCIBench hybrid v1h frozen re-evaluation

scientific_gates.g7_subgroup_completeness: for subgroups n>=10, Hush completeness >= semantic completeness - 0.05

integrity_rule: No parameter, mechanism, threshold, model revision, gate, or selector change after the holdout result is observed.
interpretation_caveat: This is a frozen re-evaluation on the same public 50-case AgentCIBench holdout previously used by Hush v1, not a newly collected untouched benchmark. It tests whether the newly frozen mechanism generalizes to that held-out set; it is not independent third-party replication.
